name: Checkout Country Flags for WooCommerce
author: krupakacpr

sections.description:
Checkout Country Flags for WooCommerce replaces the default WooCommerce country dropdown with a modern, user-friendly selector featuring country flags and improved styling.

Perfect for international stores that want to enhance checkout usability and make country selection faster, clearer and more intuitive for customers.

Features (Free)

  • Adds country flags next to each country name in the dropdown
  • Works with WooCommerce Classic Checkout and Checkout Blocks
  • Multiple flag shapes: rectangle, square, circle
  • Optional border and radius for custom appearance
  • Option to show or hide the “Country / Region” label
  • Lightweight – no external libraries required
  • Fully translatable (English & Polish included)
  • Compatible with HPOS (High Performance Order Storage)

Coming Soon – PRO Version

The upcoming PRO edition will introduce advanced features:

  • Select and restrict which countries appear in the dropdown
  • Priority countries (pin selected countries to the top)
  • Custom order of countries
  • Live-search country filtering inside the dropdown
  • Upload or override custom flag icons
  • Additional visual styles and layout options

If you’re interested in early access or creating your own plugin, contact me:
https://krupakacper.pl/

Why This Plugin?

Because the default WooCommerce dropdown is long, outdated and difficult to navigate – especially on stores selling internationally.
A dropdown with flags offers a strong visual cue and improves checkout conversion rates.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP or install directly from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Country Flags to configure appearance.
  4. Flags will automatically appear on the checkout page.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes – the plugin fully supports Checkout Blocks and Classic Checkout.

Does it work with HPOS (High Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with HPOS.

Does it slow down my checkout?

No. Flags are loaded lazily only when needed, so performance impact is minimal.

Can I limit the list of available countries?

Not in the free version.
This feature will be included in the upcoming PRO Version.

Can I add my own flags?

This will be possible in PRO Version.

Does it support translation?

Yes. The plugin includes English and Polish translations, and you can add more via .po / .mo files.
